name: Password Generator
description: Generate strong random passwords and memorable passphrases, and estimate how hard a password is to crack
help: Passwords come from the operating system's cryptographically secure random number generator in Rust.

Passphrases pick random words from built-in offline lists — easy to remember and strong: five English words give about 65 bits; the Chinese list outputs pinyin with the original words as a memory aid.
Entropy is length × log2(character pool); 80+ bits is very strong.
The strength check penalizes common passwords, repeats and keyboard or alphabet sequences; nothing is sent anywhere or stored.
Crack time assumes an offline attacker making 10 billion guesses per second.
